out_of_schema_notes: Pool host cell protein is an in-process response with no step-level spec; captured via StudyDesign.responses. QualityAttribute.acceptance_criteria holds the drug-substance criterion, which the plan states is applied only as a conservative reference here.

process_steps.description: Affinity capture on Protein A resin, operated in bind-and-elute mode: binds the antibody from clarified harvest, is the principal point of host cell protein and residual DNA removal, and sets leached Protein A — the only quality attribute the step forms. Makes no viral-clearance and no aggregate-clearance claim, and does not modify the attributes formed in cell culture.

source_references.quote: It sets one quality attribute, leached Protein A, and it is the principal point of host cell protein and residual DNA removal in the process

statements.statement_text: PCP-005 defines the Stage-1 characterization study of the A-Mab Protein A capture step (Step 5).

source_references.quote: This plan defines the Stage-1 characterization study for that step

statements.statement_text: Four parameters are assigned to multivariate study and two to univariate assessment.

source_references.quote: This plan covers the 4 process parameters that RA-001 assigned to multivariate study and the 2 parameters it assigned to univariate study

statements.statement_text: The study uses a full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central composite design on a qualified scale-down column.

source_references.quote: A face-centred central composite design will follow in the same 4 factors

statements.statement_text: Protein A sets leached Protein A and is the principal point of host cell protein and residual DNA removal.

source_references.quote: It sets one quality attribute, leached Protein A, and it is the principal point of host cell protein and residual DNA removal in the process

statements.statement_text: The operating region will be declared as the multivariate subset of the characterization ranges over which every attribute with a criterion stays inside it.

source_references.quote: The operating region will be declared as the multivariate subset of the characterization ranges over which every attribute with a criterion is predicted to stay inside that criterion.

statements.statement_text: A response with no significant term is pre-declared as a robustness result, and no operating limit is derived from an effect the study could not resolve.

source_references.quote: A response with no significant term is a result and will be reported as one.

assertions.assertion_text: Leached Protein A acceptance: 0–5 ppm at drug substance.

source_references.quote: the criterion of 5 ppm is the direct responsibility of this study

assertions.assertion_text: Host cell protein acceptance: 0–100 ng/mg at drug substance; the criterion is not applied at the outlet of this step.

source_references.quote: Pool host cell protein will be judged against the drug-substance criterion of 100 ng/mg

assertions.assertion_text: Protein load is expected to affect the pool host cell protein.

source_references.quote: a high load is expected to raise the host cell protein carried into the eluate

assertions.assertion_text: Elution buffer pH is expected to affect the pool host cell protein.

source_references.quote: both pool host cell protein and leached Protein A are expected to rise as the elution pH falls

assertions.assertion_text: Load flow rate is expected to affect only process performance.

source_references.quote: its effect is expected on step yield and not on the quality attributes

assertions.assertion_text: Operating temperature is expected to affect only process performance.

source_references.quote: Temperature acts on binding kinetics and on the rate of ligand hydrolysis, and both processes are slow compared with the residence time of the step

assertions.assertion_text: Bed height is expected to affect only process performance.

source_references.quote: Bed height acts on residence time at a fixed linear velocity, so its influence is already spanned by the load flow rate factor
